utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Mina, I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch and could really use a few helpers. If you’re free, I’d love to count on you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I can help—I'll be there Saturday around 10 a.m. on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Sam — I’m still lining up a few helpers for the Saturday front-porch repair drive, and I’ll send the time and what to bring soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Vik — just send the time and what to bring when you have it, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know what time to show up and what tools I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the time and a tool list as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — if you know anyone free, I’d really appreciate the help for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still looking for a few more helpers for Saturday on the front porch. If you know anyone who can spare an hour, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for the reminder. I’m still looking for a few helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I’d really appreciate any support you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you tell me what time it starts and what you need helpers to bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Tess, I’m happy to help this Saturday. Just send me the start time and anything you want me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks so much, Sam! I’ll send you the start time and a quick list of what to bring right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rosa — that’s really helpful. I’m still lining up helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I’ll send you the time and what to bring soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Vik — just send me the time and what to bring, and I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know what time to be there and what tools I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia. Saturday at 10 on the front porch should work, and a basic screwdriver and work gloves would be enough.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
